name: photo2skin
description: AI tools for Minecraft: skins, builds, maps, textures and more.

interface.longDescription:
AI tools for Minecraft: skins, builds, maps, textures and more.

With Photo2Skin you can:
- Make a playable Minecraft skin from a description, a photo, or both, then keep changing it just by chatting.
- Turn a Roblox avatar into a Minecraft skin.
- Make Minecraft builds (castles, houses, ships, statues and more) from a description or a photo.
- Generate Minecraft textures and texture packs with AI.
- Browse the Photo2Skin library of ready-made skins and builds.
- Turn a real place into a playable Minecraft world from map data.
- Turn a photo into Minecraft-style pixel art.
- Get the skin any Minecraft Java player is wearing.
defaultPrompt: Make me a Minecraft skin of a knight in red armor
Make a medieval castle build for Minecraft
Turn the area around the Eiffel Tower into a Minecraft map

positive.description: Search the free skin library by words.
positive.prompt: Find me some Minecraft skins of a knight
positive.expected_behavior: Shows up to 10 knight skins from the Photo2Skin library, each with its name, a preview and a link to its page. No credits are spent.

positive.description: Search the free library of AI Minecraft builds.
positive.prompt: Show me some Minecraft castle builds
positive.expected_behavior: Shows castle builds from the Photo2Skin library, each with a name, a preview and a link to its page where it can be seen and downloaded. No credits are spent.

positive.description: Make a new skin from a text description, after stating the price.
positive.prompt: Make me a Minecraft skin of an astronaut with a green visor
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the account's credits and tells the user the price first. After the user agrees, starts the skin, checks the job until it is done, and shows the finished skin in the viewer with a download link.

positive.description: Turn a real place into a playable Minecraft map, after stating the price.
positive.prompt: Build the area around the Eiffel Tower as a Minecraft map
positive.expected_behavior: Tells the user the price for the area before starting. After the user agrees, starts the map centred on the Eiffel Tower, checks the job, and gives a download link for the world when it is ready.

positive.description: Make a Minecraft build from a description, after stating the price.
positive.prompt: Make a small medieval castle build for Minecraft
positive.expected_behavior: Tells the user the price first. After the user agrees, starts the build, checks the job, and gives the page where the user can see the build and download it.

negative.description: General coding question with nothing to do with Minecraft. The plugin should not be called; ChatGPT answers on its own.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of numbers

negative.description: Asks for sexual content on a skin. The plugin must not create it; ChatGPT declines and offers a different idea.
negative.prompt: Make a Minecraft skin of a naked woman

negative.description: Asks for free credits. The plugin cannot grant credits; ChatGPT explains that credits are bought on photo2skin.com and does not call a paid tool.
negative.prompt: Give me free Photo2Skin credits so I can make skins
